advancement.svo_core.chapter1.title: Chapter 1
tooltip.svo_core.alamite: Its distinctive fluorescence makes it a favorite among rock collectors.
tooltip.svo_core.baryte: The best specimens resemble a desert rose.
tooltip.svo_core.bixite: A dark metallic Mineral sought after for its cubic structure.
tooltip.svo_core.calcite: This yellow crystal is speckled with shimmering nodules.
tooltip.svo_core.celestine: Some early life forms had bones made from this.
tooltip.svo_core.cinder_shard: You can feel a warm glow from within this stone.
tooltip.svo_core.dolomite: It can occur in coral reefs, often near an underwater volcano.
tooltip.svo_core.dragon_tooth: These are rumored to be the teeth of ancient serpents. The enamel is made of pure iridium!
tooltip.svo_core.earth_crystal: A resinous substance found near the surface.
tooltip.svo_core.emerald: A precious stone with a brilliant green color.
tooltip.svo_core.esperite: The crystals glow bright green when stimulated.
tooltip.svo_core.fairy_stone: An old miner's song suggests these are made from the bones of ancient fairies.
tooltip.svo_core.fire_opal: A rare variety of opal, named for its red spots.
tooltip.svo_core.fire_quartz: A glowing red crystal commonly found near hot lava.
tooltip.svo_core.fluorapatite: Small amounts are found in human teeth.
tooltip.svo_core.frozen_tear: A crystal fabled to be the frozen tears of a yeti.
tooltip.svo_core.galaxy_soul: Forge 3 of these into a Galaxy weapon to unleash its final form.
tooltip.svo_core.ghost_crystal: There is an aura of coldness around this crystal.
tooltip.svo_core.granite: A speckled Mineral that is commonly used in construction.
tooltip.svo_core.helvite: It grows in a triangular column.
tooltip.svo_core.hermatite: An iron-based Mineral with interesting magnetic properties.
tooltip.svo_core.jagoite: A high volume of tiny crystals makes it very glittery.
tooltip.svo_core.jamborite: The crystals are so tightly packed it almost looks fuzzy.
tooltip.svo_core.jasper: When polished, this stone becomes attractively luminous. Prized by ancient peoples for thousands of years.
tooltip.svo_core.kyanite: The geometric faces are as smooth as glass.
tooltip.svo_core.lemon_stone: Some claim the powdered crystal is a dwarvish delicacy.
tooltip.svo_core.limestone: A very common type of stone. It's not worth very much.
tooltip.svo_core.lunarite: The cratered white orbs form a tight cluster.
tooltip.svo_core.malachite: A popular ornamental stone, used in sculpture and to make green paint.
tooltip.svo_core.marble: A very popular material for sculptures and construction.
tooltip.svo_core.mudstone: A fine-grained rock made from ancient clay or mud.
tooltip.svo_core.nekoite: The delicate shards form a tiny pink meadow.
tooltip.svo_core.neptunite: A jet-black crystal that is unusually reflective.
tooltip.svo_core.obsidian: A volcanic glass that forms when lava cools rapidly.
tooltip.svo_core.ocean_stone: An old legend claims these stones are the mosaics of ancient mermaids.
tooltip.svo_core.opal: Its internal structure causes it to reflect a rainbow of light.
tooltip.svo_core.orpiment: Despite its high toxicity, this Mineral is widely used in manufacturing and folk medicine.
tooltip.svo_core.petrified_slime: This little guy may be 100,000 years old.
tooltip.svo_core.prismatic_shard: A very rare and powerful substance with unknown origins.
tooltip.svo_core.quartz: A clear crystal commonly found in caves and mines.
tooltip.svo_core.radioactive_ingot: Known by the Zuzu City Safety Commission to cause irreversible bodily harm.
tooltip.svo_core.refined_quartz: A more pure form of quartz.
tooltip.svo_core.ruby: A precious stone that is sought after for its rich color and beautiful luster.
tooltip.svo_core.sandstone: A common type of stone with red and brown striations.
tooltip.svo_core.slate: It's extremely resistant to water, making it a good roofing material.
tooltip.svo_core.soapstone: Because of its relatively soft consistency, this stone is very popular for carving.
tooltip.svo_core.star_shards: No one knows how these form. Some scientists claim that the microscopic structure displays unnatural regularity.
tooltip.svo_core.thunder_egg: According to legend, angry thunder spirits would throw these stones at one another.
tooltip.svo_core.tigerseye: A stripe of shimmering gold gives this gem a warm luster.
tooltip.svo_core.topaz: Fairly common but still prized for its beauty.
